digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions CI pipeline / pytest reusable workflow
propositions: GitHub Actions pytest matrix jobs on stale Gerrit patchsets 1129/1130/1131/1136 hang at 99% progress for 1.7–4.3 hours due to lazy per-blob git fetches caused by omitted commit 96a0d5c3f (blob refill fix).

The reusable workflow _build-and-test.yml test job lacks a timeout-minutes configuration, defaulting to GitHub's 360-minute limit, which allows hung workers to block the queue until manual cancellation.

FakeJiraClient.search_issues in test_jira_dc_transport.py ignored startAt/maxResults pagination parameters, causing test_comment_map_matches_the_shared_contract to loop infinitely and timeout when _paged_search was introduced in patchset 1129.
Workflow fix: adding jobs.test.timeout-minutes: 60 to _build-and-test.yml bounds job execution and prevents manual-clear dependence.
Test fix: FakeJiraClient.search_issues must slice results using startAt/maxResults kwargs to produce empty terminal pages and exit pagination loops correctly.
